name: Student / Intern Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires enrollment in a higher-education programme, or a training/internship placement, on Sint Maarten.

evidence_required.document: Institution acceptance letter or internship/training placement letter

outcome.duration_length: temporary, tied to length of study/training programme

sources.title: Ministry of Justice, Government of Sint Maarten -- Immigration and Border Protection Services: Student/Intern residence pathway for foreign nationals pursuing higher education or training programmes on Sint Maarten

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Sint Maarten's initial build. Very little detail beyond the ground's existence was found on the pages reviewed -- no fee, duration cap, or explicit no-paid-work statement specific to this permit (though the general tourist no-paid-work rule and the work-permit-requires-separate-employment-permit rule strongly imply no work rights here either); modelled conservatively as no work rights, consistent with how student permits are modelled elsewhere in this dataset absent evidence to the contrary. Duration, fees, and whether limited internship-related work is allowed (as in several other countries' student routes this session) were not confirmed -- flagged as a gap rather than assumed.
